definition: Showing deep, thoughtful understanding of fundamental questions and principles.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: He recalled his own criticisms of Tyndall of his complacent satisfaction in the cleverness of his experiments, and for his lack of philosophic insight.
example_sentence: After the third rejection she took a philosophic view and ordered pizza.
